authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES an execution-remainder join for some DR-133 NT classes and records which classes remain leftover-design. It does not close leftover-design. registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-133 |'. Compare row text, not a remembered line number.

g10Quoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-G10 '.
g10Quoted.claimVerbatim: TS major 1 and Rust merged major 2 remain opaque, one-shot, fate-compatible subprotocols
g10Quoted.harnessVerbatim: named: harness.DR-G10.provider-conformance.ts-major-1 (D-086; not authored; not QUALIFIED). exact V1 goldens, D9/fault joins, no-reuse/process cleanup

g10DoesNotOwn: G10's claim is opacity / one-shot / fate-compatibility. Its harness executes V1 goldens, D9/fault joins, and no-reuse/process cleanup as byte/fate parity and lifetime results. It does not own host refusal of component findings, policy, Coverage-domain mutation, or planAdmission. NT-6 is a component-minted D9/HostTermination refusal, which is host admission, not G10's D9/fault-join golden over the existing closed wire.
